# Motion layers and drawing tools

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `vector`
- Slug: `vector/layers-tools`

## Summary

The layer types a Motion document holds and the drawing tools with their shortcuts.

## Details

### Layer types
- `group` (Group)
- `path` (Path)
- `rect` (Rectangle)
- `ellipse` (Ellipse)
- `line` (Line)
- `polyline` (Polyline)
- `polygon` (Polygon)
- `text` (Text)
- `image` (Image)
- `use` (Instance)
- `raw` (Kept as-is)
Groups nest layers; imported SVG becomes editable layers (groups, paths, shapes, text, images, gradients, masks, clip paths); unsupported markup is kept as-is.
### Tools
- `select` (Select): key V
- `node` (Edit nodes): key A
- `rect` (Rectangle): key R
- `ellipse` (Ellipse): key O
- `line` (Line): key L
- `pen` (Pen): key P
- `text` (Text): key T
- `hand` (Pan): key H
Styling: fill, stroke, stroke width, linecap/linejoin, opacity, linear and radial gradients, masks and clip paths.
